fieldNotes.resolvedLocation: Roster coords (1000 Coulon Rd) landed in a residential neighborhood. Correct facility is at 244 Highway 3266 (Plant 1) / 234 Highway 3266 (Plant 2), resolved to 29.805705,-90.829764 via web research and confirmed by satellite - a large multi-building manufacturing campus (sugarcane harvesters, CAMECO heritage) bordered by sugarcane fields.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus - no controlled truck entrance at the road frontage. The access road off Highway 3266 runs directly between the office building and the manufacturing buildings; Street View (2025-10) shows an open frontage with parking and no barrier arm, gate, or guard booth. An interior fence/drainage line runs along the east edge but no gate confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth confirmed at the entrance. A staffed reception is plausible inside the office building but no standalone gate booth observed - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no truck gate at the property line.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access roads from Highway 3266 to the docks and material yards; would hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors scattered across several building faces (N face and SE face), with a few trailers backed in; estimated 10-25 total, low-confidence count typical of an assembly plant where finished sugarcane harvesters ship by flatbed/drive-off.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Modest trailer presence (~10 trailers) plus extensive material laydown in the SE/E yards; 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks present on multiple building faces but no clearly separated ship vs. receive clusters discernible.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site outside Thibodaux, LA, surrounded by sugarcane fields with an adjacent residential pocket; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building campus - two large manufacturing buildings (Plant 1 + Plant 2) plus an office building and several support/storage buildings (8+ structures).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer/equipment staging and laydown yards present on the SE/E side, distinct from active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur observed entering the property.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is rural but immediately adjacent to the town of Thibodaux; cellular coverage likely adequate - connectivityIssue set false.

citations.claim: Louisiana ED: Deere investing $29.8M to expand Thibodaux plant, +70 jobs, retaining 284, shifting cotton-harvester production from China to Thibodaux.

verification.rationale: Deere-operated cotton/sugarcane harvester plant; actively expanded 2022-2025.
